title: Universal cyclotomic Hecke ordered monomials form a basis
status: necessary new research registration draft; not native
statement: For R=Z[z^(±1),U_1^(±1),...,U_ell^(±1)], ell>=1, the nondegenerate cyclotomic Hecke presentation at first-variable polynomial product(X_1-U_a) is free over R with basis X^a T_w, 0<=a_i<ell. This basis specializes to every commutative R-algebra. Rank zero has singleton empty word; level zero at positive rank is separately zero.

title: The universal cyclotomic Hecke canonical trace is perfect and symmetric
status: necessary new research registration draft; not native
statement: For the preceding universal presentation, the functional extracting coefficient of the empty dot profile and identity permutation in the ordered PBW basis is symmetric and gives a perfect R-bilinear associative pairing. It specializes to every commutative R-algebra. All z,U_a are units. Rank zero is R with trace1; level zero at positive rank has the zero perfect pairing, without trace(1)=1.
